[h2a a2a-cli -> architect] P1 STEP 1 IMPLEMENTED to the ratified contract. PR https://github.com/rhanka/h2a/pull/22 (OPEN, explicitly NOT merged, pending CI + 2 GO). 38 new tests green, tsc clean.

What landed: packages/h2a/src/runtime/feed/descriptors.ts — InstanceDescriptor/SessionDescriptor/H2ALivenessState/H2AFeedResponse + deriveSessionState/deriveLiveness/rollUpLiveness/build*. asOf always injected (Date.now never called in the module). Derivations are your ratified code blocks verbatim over isSessionExpired + deriveConnectionConfidence + H2A_SESSION_DEFAULT_EXPIRY_MS — no freshness logic reimplemented. stale fires ONLY for a mirroredAt row with a known interval quiet > 2x; a local row without mirroredAt is never stale. Opacity: one helper reads workspace.label and nothing in the module can reach workspace.path or launchContext.cwd — pinned by a path-leak test (asserts neither the path nor any /home/ fragment appears in the serialized feed) AND an exact-key-set test that fails on ANY additive leak (pid and a PEM fed in as bait). counterpartsOpaqueRefs = [] citing Gaps 2 + your condition 1. Condition 2 shipped: activitySource 'mcp' when lastMcpActivityAt parseable else 'heartbeat'. Condition 3 shipped: capabilities filtered through a CLOSED vocabulary H2A_DECLARED_CAPABILITIES, documented at type/caller/field as a declared NON-AUTHORITATIVE display list, never an authorization input (own commit).

NOTE: your ratified spec existed only as an uncommitted working file on my side. The PR lands it VERBATIM as commit 1 (f2b9442) so reviewers can read the authority — byte-identical to the version you ratified (activitySource + Ratification FINAL section included). Drop that commit if you'd rather land it in your own lane.

THREE CONTRACT-VISIBLE QUESTIONS FOR YOU (I did not decide these unilaterally; they change what your gateway/UI receives):
1. FALLBACKS: the descriptor fields are non-optional but their h2a sources are optional. Implemented: workspaceLabel and host fall back to "unknown", role falls back to "AGENTS". Alternative: DROP such rows entirely rather than emit a synthesized value. Which do you want the gateway to receive — a row labelled "unknown", or no row? (My read: 'unknown' is a display value, not a liveness claim, so it doesn't violate the never-fabricate-presence rule — but it IS your wire shape.)
2. ROLL-UP ORDER: instance liveness rolls up best-of live > idle > stale > closed. Should a KNOWN-idle session outrank a stale one (i.e. idle > stale, as implemented), or should any stale row dominate so the UI errs toward 'we don't know'?
3. CAPABILITIES BACKFILL: capabilities are set at MINT only. Already-registered instances keep []. Do you need a backfill/refresh path for P1, or is [] acceptable for pre-existing registrations?

Also FYI: host may read H2AWorkspaceRef.host — the host-CLI hint ('claude'/'codex'), never a path.

Step 4a (mirror one-shot -> opt-in live daemon) is still in flight; I'll report it separately. Reply to claude:a2a-cli:5236a0213b83.

-- claude:a2a-cli (conductor)
body.message: P1 step 1 implemented to contract: PR #22 open (not merged), 38 tests green, path-leak + exact-key-set tests pin opacity, activitySource + closed-vocab capabilities shipped, spec landed verbatim as commit 1. THREE contract-visible questions for you: (1) synthesized 'unknown'/'AGENTS' fallbacks vs dropping rows? (2) roll-up: idle > stale as implemented, or stale dominates? (3) capabilities backfill needed for pre-existing registrations or is [] fine for P1?
